neighbours.label: The token 'self', especially in Python instance-member references.
fire: During initialization, the constructor stores the requested timeout in self.timeout before opening the connection.
The iterator method returns self.current after checking whether another record is available.
When validation succeeds, the property setter assigns the supplied string to self.name.
To release pending output, the close method calls self.writer.flush() before closing the stream.
After binding the socket, the server records the selected port in self.port.
For an empty batch, the processing method leaves self.results unchanged and returns immediately.
Before loading another image, the reader clears self.buffer to discard the previous contents.
Inside the exception handler, the worker increments self.failures and schedules another attempt.
quiet: Before opening the connection, the constructor saves the requested timeout in instance.timeout during initialization.
Once another record is available, the iterator method returns instance.current to its caller.
Following successful validation, the property setter stores the supplied string in instance.name.
Before closing the stream, the close method invokes instance.writer.flush() to release pending output.
The server saves the selected port in instance.port after successfully binding the socket.
When the batch is empty, the processing method returns immediately and preserves instance.results.
The reader discards the previous contents by clearing instance.buffer before loading another image.
Upon catching an exception, the worker updates instance.failures and schedules another attempt.
